/** Keep normal odds until 5 endless minutes, then linearly reach all elites at 10. */
export function eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds = null) {
  if (endlessSeconds === null) return eliteChance;
  const s = endlessEliteSettings;
  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    (endlessSeconds - s.rampStartSeconds) / Math.max(1, s.rampEndSeconds - s.rampStartSeconds)));
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, eliteChance + (s.targetChance - eliteChance) * progress));
}

export const mobBaseHp = 60;
export const shirokoBossStats = { hp: 25000, hpMultiplier: 100, contactDamage: 20 };
// New Mob spawns scale with survival time; linear by default, continuing after 15 minutes.
export const mobHealthScaling = { targetSeconds: 15 * 60, targetHp: 350, exponent: 1 };
// Timer text size and gap in pixels below the top EXP bar.
export const survivalTimerSettings = { fontScale: 1.25, offsetBelowExp: 8 };

/** Basic Mob HP: 60 + (350-60) * (survivalSeconds/900)^1, rounded. */
export function basicMobHpFormula(seconds) {
  const progress = Math.max(0, seconds) / mobHealthScaling.targetSeconds;
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(mobBaseHp + (mobHealthScaling.targetHp - mobBaseHp) *
    progress ** mobHealthScaling.exponent));
}

export const yuukaSpawnSettings = { baseChance: 0.0025, unlockKills: 100, cooldownKills: 100,
  pityStart: 500, pityStepKills: 50, pityStepChance: 0.005, maxChance: 0.025 };

/** Chance after unlock/cooldown: .25%, plus .5 percentage points per pity step, capped at 2.5%. */
export function yuukaSpawnChanceFormula(kills, hasSpawned = false, bossActive = false) {
  const settings = yuukaSpawnSettings;
  if (kills < settings.unlockKills || (hasSpawned && kills < settings.cooldownKills)) return 0;
  const steps = Math.floor(Math.max(0, kills - settings.pityStart) / settings.pityStepKills);
  return Math.min(settings.maxChance, settings.baseChance + steps * settings.pityStepChance) *
    (bossActive ? specialEnemySettings.bossSpawnMultiplier : 1);
}

}

// Enemy damage scales with current player level and active survival minutes.
export const enemyDamageScaling = { base: 1, levelDivisor: 6, minutesDivisor: 4 };

/** floor(enemyBase * variantMultiplier * (1 + (level/6) * (minutes/4))). */
export function enemyContactDamageFormula(baseDamage, level, survivalSeconds, variantMultiplier = 1) {
  const s = enemyDamageScaling;
  const minutes = Math.max(0, survivalSeconds) / 60;
  const scale = s.base + (Math.max(1, level) / s.levelDivisor) * (minutes / s.minutesDivisor);
  return Math.max(0, Math.floor(baseDamage * variantMultiplier * scale));
}

/** Nearest integer with ties to even, used by the EXP curve. */
export function roundToEven(value) {
  const lower = Math.floor(value), fraction = value - lower;
  return fraction === 0.5 ? lower + (lower % 2) : Math.round(value);
}
export function levelExpFormula(level) {
  const current = Math.max(1, Math.floor(level));
  return current === 1 ? 79 : roundToEven((4 * (current + 1)) ** 2.1) - roundToEven((4 * current) ** 2.1);
}

/** Standard Mob report: round(3 + playerLevel / (2 + reportTier)). */
export function mobExpFormula(level, tier) {
  return Math.round(reportSettings.mobBase + Math.max(1, Math.floor(level)) /
    (reportSettings.mobDivisor + Math.max(0, Math.min(3, Math.floor(tier)))));
}

/** Yuuka spawn HP: round((normal player damage + 100) / 100 * 900). */
export const yuukaHpSettings = { offset: 100, divisor: 100, base: 900 };
export function yuukaHpFormula(damage) {
  return Math.max(1, Math.round((Math.max(0, damage) + yuukaHpSettings.offset) /
    yuukaHpSettings.divisor * yuukaHpSettings.base));
}

/** ATK/SPD/PICKUP/Haste percent bonus multiplier (25% -> 1.25). */
export function percentBonusFormula(percent) {
  return 1 + Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(Number(percent)) ? Number(percent) : 0) / 100;
}

¦Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¡ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€¦Ã‚Â¡ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â±10% above20. Do not randomize values<=2.
  const variance = base > damageRules.randomizeAbove
    ? Math.max(base * damageRules.variancePercent, damageRules.minimumVariance) : 0;
  const randomized = variance ? base - variance + random() * variance * 2 : base;
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(randomized * Math.max(0, damageMod)));
}

/** Crowd-adjusted arrivals: 8/s empty -> 5/s at40 nearby; 2/s at50 visible slots. */
export function spawnRateFormula(nearby, visible) {
  const s = playtestSpawnSettings;
  if (visible >= s.visibleLimit) return s.crowdedPerSecond;
  return Math.round(s.perSecond + (s.maxPerSecond - s.perSecond) *
    (1 - Math.min(1, nearby / s.nearbyTarget)));
}

/** Boss chance per eligible kill; charge freezes while any boss is alive. */
export function bossPityThresholds(endlessSeconds = null) {
  const s = bossSpawnSettings;
  return endlessSeconds !== null && endlessSeconds >= s.lateEndlessSeconds
    ? { unlockKills: s.lateUnlockKills, pityStart: s.latePityStart, guaranteedKills: s.lateGuaranteedKills }
    : { unlockKills: s.unlockKills, pityStart: s.pityStart, guaranteedKills: s.guaranteedKills };
}

/** Select the live pity curve using time since completing Stage 4, keeping the existing kill counter. */
export function bossChanceFormula(kills, endlessSeconds = null) {
  const s = { ...bossSpawnSettings, ...bossPityThresholds(endlessSeconds) };
  if (kills < s.unlockKills) return 0;
  const pity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (kills - s.pityStart) / (s.guaranteedKills - s.pityStart)));
  return s.baseChance + (1 - s.baseChance) * pity;
}


/** Growth is inactive until purchased; costs are reserved for the future upgrade shop. */
export const growthSettings = {
  defaultRank: 0, maxRank: 3, damagePerLevelPerRank: 0.1,
  rankCosts: [500, 10000, 50000], tickThresholdFrames: 20, minimumTickMultiplier: 0.2
};

/** Multiply independent base-weapon bonuses; Growth stays outside this product.
 * Weapon damage uses factors (120% = 1.2). Hit cooldown is measured in 60Hz frames.
 * Only primary projectiles count toward the split, not secondary/on-hit effects.
 */
export function weaponDamageFormula(baseWeaponDamage, bonusesPercent = [], {
  growthRank = 0, playerLevel = 1, growthEligible = false,
  projectileCount = 1, hitCooldownFrames = 60, enhancementRank = 0
} = {}) {
  const weapon = baseWeaponDamage * bonusesPercent.reduce((value, bonus) => value * (1 + bonus / 100), 1);
  const rank = Math.max(0, Math.min(growthSettings.maxRank, Math.floor(growthRank)));
  const tickMultiplier = Math.min(1, Math.max(growthSettings.minimumTickMultiplier,
    hitCooldownFrames / growthSettings.tickThresholdFrames));
  const growth = growthEligible ? growthSettings.damagePerLevelPerRank / damageRules.baseScale *
    rank * Math.max(1, playerLevel) / Math.max(1, projectileCount) * tickMultiplier : 0;
  // Enhancements add flat damage after level/enchantment bonuses, split over primary projectiles.
  const enhancement=Math.max(0,Math.floor(enhancementRank))*crafterSettings.enhancementDamagePerRank/damageRules.baseScale/Math.max(1,projectileCount);
  return weapon + growth + enhancement;
}


/** Haste changes start-to-start timing only; quantize to60Hz frames, minimum one frame. */
export function attackTimeFormula(baseSeconds, hastePercent = 0, minimumFrames = 1) {
  return Math.max(1, minimumFrames, Math.round(baseSeconds * 60 /
    (1 + Math.max(0, hastePercent) / 100))) / 60;
}

/** Standard base40px; characters may override their starting radius (including zero). */
export function pickupRangeFormula(bonusPercent = 0, baseRadius = 40) {
  return Math.max(0, baseRadius + 0.4 * bonusPercent);
}


/** ATK values are percentage points: base100 + bonuses20+30 = total150%. */
export const attackStatSettings = { baseATK: 100 };
export function totalATKFormula(baseATK = attackStatSettings.baseATK, bonuses = []) {
  return baseATK + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + bonus, 0);
}


/** Critical modifier is bonus percentage points: +50% means1.5x total damage. */
export function totalCritModFormula(baseCritMod = (combatBalance.criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100, bonuses = []) {
  return baseCritMod + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + bonus, 0);
}


/** Target vulnerability debuffs add percentage points, then multiply final damage. */
export function bonusDamageTakenFormula(bonuses = []) {
  return 1 + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + bonus, 0) / 100;
}


/** Damage Bonus sources use multipliers:1.2x and1.3x stack to1.5x. */
export function damageBonusFormula(bonuses = []) {
  return 1 + bonuses.reduce((sum, bonus) => sum + (bonus - 1), 0);
}


/** Independent target reductions multiply; values are percentage points (20 =20%). */
export function damageReductionFormula(reductions = []) {
  return reductions.reduce((multiplier, reduction) =>
    multiplier * (1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(100, reduction)) / 100), 1);
}


/** Halo item: threshold is inclusive for the far bonus; level0 means unequipped. */
export const haloSettings = { distanceThreshold: 130, closeMultiplier: 0.9,
  farMultipliers: [1.2, 1.4, 1.6] };
export function haloDamageFormula(distance, level = 0) {
  const rank = Math.max(0, Math.min(haloSettings.farMultipliers.length, Math.floor(level)));
  if (!rank) return 1;
  return distance < haloSettings.distanceThreshold ? haloSettings.closeMultiplier :
    haloSettings.farMultipliers[rank - 1];
}


/** Combine independent modifier categories; each category aggregates its own sources first. */
export function damageModifiersFormula({ criticalMultiplier = 1, bonusDamageTaken = 1,
  DB = 1, DR = 1, halo = 1, attackModifier = 1 } = {}) {
  return criticalMultiplier * bonusDamageTaken * DB * DR * halo * attackModifier;
}


/** Special-enemy stats are snapshots at spawn, using timer components, not total minutes.
 * SPD is a ratio of unmodified playerSettings.speed; callers convert it to movement units.
 * These profiles are opt-in pending enemy assignments and attack implementation.
 */
export function specialEnemyStatsFormula(type, elapsedSeconds = 0) {
  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(elapsedSeconds));
  const minuteTimer = Math.floor(seconds / 60) % 60;
  const secondTimer = seconds % 60;
  if (type === 'bomber-boss') {
    return {
      atk: 2 + 0.225 * minuteTimer,
      spd: 0.42 + 0.018 * minuteTimer,
      hp: Math.round(1000 + 1000 ** (1 + minuteTimer / 25)),
      expValue: Math.round(750 ** (1 + minuteTimer / 60)),
      instantKOImmune: true
    };
  }
  if (type !== 'shooter' && type !== 'bomber') {
    throw new RangeError('Special stat profile must be shooter, bomber or bomber-boss.');
  }
  return {
    atk: 2 + minuteTimer * (type === 'shooter' ? 0.8 : 0.15),
    spd: 0.35 + 0.015 * minuteTimer,
    hp: Math.round(4 ** (3.6 + minuteTimer / 8.5) - 127),
    expValue: Math.round(5 ** (1 + (minuteTimer + secondTimer / 30) / 25))
  };
}


/** Reference time scaling uses full elapsed minute/hour components. */
export function enemyTimeScalingFormula(elapsedSeconds = 0) {
  const seconds = Math.max(0, elapsedSeconds);
  const fullMinutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const minuteTimer = fullMinutes % 60;
  const hourTimer = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
  const minutesPast30 = Math.max(0, fullMinutes - 30);
  const hourPast1 = Math.max(0, hourTimer - 1);
  return { a: Math.max(0, minuteTimer - 23) + 37 * hourTimer,
    b: minutesPast30 + 60 * hourPast1 };
}

/** Minute-quantized reference stats; rounding HP/ATK is left to damage/entity consumers. */
export function enemyStatsScalingFormula({ baseATK, baseSPD, baseHP }, elapsedSeconds = 0) {
  const { a, b } = enemyTimeScalingFormula(elapsedSeconds);
  return {
    atk: (baseATK + 2 * a) ** (1 + b / 25),
    spd: Math.min(300, (baseSPD + 0.12 * a) ** (1 + b / 25)),
    hp: (baseHP + baseHP * 0.05 * a) ** (1 + b / 50)
  };
}

/** Optional project clock: campaign stays unscaled; endless starts at reference23:00.
 * Supply active seconds since Stage4 completion, or null before endless.
 * Reference a first increases one full minute later; no enemy-pool swap is implied.
 */
export function campaignScalingTimeFormula(endlessSeconds = null) {
  return endlessSeconds === null ? 0 : 23 * 60 + Math.max(0, endlessSeconds);
}


/** Final score weights; boss/miniboss bonuses supplement the overall enemy defeat count. */
export const scoreSettings = {
  enemy: 75, miniBoss: 428, boss: 2251, minutePast30: 20126,
  minute: 126, second: 10, level: 1219,
  hardcoreMinute: 0.01, hardcoreHour: 1.2
};

/** Calculate a score snapshot with timer components, preserving the supplied hour rules.
 * Hardcore is opt-in; this helper does not implement a Hardcore game mode or publish scores.
 */
export function scoreFormula({ enemyDefeated = 0, miniBossDefeated = 0, bossDefeated = 0,
  playerLevel = 1, elapsedSeconds = 0, hardcore = false } = {}) {
  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(elapsedSeconds));
  const finalHourValue = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
  const finalMinuteValue = Math.floor(seconds / 60) % 60;
  const finalSecondValue = seconds % 60;
  const s = scoreSettings;
  const baseScore = enemyDefeated * s.enemy + miniBossDefeated * s.miniBoss + bossDefeated * s.boss +
    Math.max(0, finalMinuteValue - 30) * s.minutePast30 + Math.min(59, finalMinuteValue) * s.minute +
    Math.min(59, finalSecondValue) * s.second + playerLevel * s.level;
  const hardcoreBonus = hardcore ? Math.floor(baseScore *
    (finalMinuteValue * s.hardcoreMinute + finalHourValue * s.hardcoreHour)) : 0;
  return { baseScore, hardcoreBonus, finalScore: Math.floor(baseScore + hardcoreBonus) };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Game/gif-animation.js | sha256=85d169d5ceb087474fb51eb11599ffa1dfd18a2664f87a9ea58aa1044331e03f | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
/** Load predecoded GIF display frames while retaining original frame durations. */
export async function loadGifAnimation(character) {
  character.animationFrames = await Promise.all(character.gifFrames.map(frame =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const image = new Image();
      image.onload = () => resolve({ image, duration: frame.duration });
      image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${frame.source}.`));
      image.src = frame.source;
    })
  ));
  character.image = character.animationFrames[0].image;
}

/** Select the original GIF frame for elapsed playback time, including while idle. */
export function gifFrameAt(frames, elapsed) {
  const total = frames.reduce((sum, frame) => sum + frame.duration, 0);
  let time = elapsed % total;
  for (let i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) {
    time -= frames[i].duration;
    if (time < 0) return i;
  }
  return 0;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Game/golden-crafter-rules.js | sha256=b821c75f03ad1427231d89c3c9a0c62bba56789f40807da6e406d5a2f708460d | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import {superSynergyChoices,applySuperSynergyChoice} from './super-synergy-rules.js';
import { synergyRecipes } from './synergy-recipes.js';
import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Use each weapon's actual MAX level, including future weapon definitions. */
function maximumLevel(weapon) {
  return weapon.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:
    weapon.id==='aris-laser'?arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel:weapon.maxLevel;
}

/** Only compatible, equipped MAX pairs can cause a Golden Crafter drop or fusion choice. */
export function goldenCrafterChoices(player,recipes=synergyRecipes) {
  const slots=player.attackSlots||[],choices=[];
  for(const recipe of recipes) {
    if(!recipe.id||!recipe.result?.id||recipe.ingredients?.length!==2||slots.some(w=>w?.id===recipe.result.id))continue;
    for(let a=0;a<Math.min(6,slots.length);a++)for(let b=a+1;b<Math.min(6,slots.length);b++) {
      const first=slots[a],second=slots[b];if(!first||!second)continue;
      const ids=[first.id,second.id].sort(),needed=[...recipe.ingredients].sort();
      if(ids[0]!==needed[0]||ids[1]!==needed[1])continue;
      if(!Number.isFinite(maximumLevel(first))||!Number.isFinite(maximumLevel(second))||
        (first.level||1)<maximumLevel(first)||(second.level||1)<maximumLevel(second))continue;
      choices.push({id:`synergy:${recipe.id}:${a}:${b}`,name:recipe.result.name||recipe.result.id,
        label:'Fuse MAX weapons',kind:'synergy',target:recipe.result,recipe,slots:[a,b],disabled:false,
        description:recipe.description||`Fuse ${first.name||first.id} and ${second.name||second.id} into ${recipe.result.name||recipe.result.id}.`});
    }
  }
  return [...choices,...(typeof superSynergyChoices==='function'?superSynergyChoices(player):[])];
}

/** Replace the two ingredients with one synergy atomically; cancellation never calls this. */
export function applyGoldenCrafterChoice(player,id,recipes=synergyRecipes) {
  if(id.startsWith('super-synergy:'))return applySuperSynergyChoice(player,id);
  const choice=goldenCrafterChoices(player,recipes).find(choice=>choice.id===id);
  if(!choice)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'No compatible MAX-level weapon pair.'};
  let result;
  try{result=choice.recipe.createWeapon?choice.recipe.createWeapon():{...choice.recipe.result};}
  catch{return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Fusion unavailable. The Golden Crafter was not used.'};}
  if(!result||result.id!==choice.recipe.result.id)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Fusion unavailable.'};
  const [a,b]=choice.slots;
  const enchantments=choice.slots.flatMap(index=>{
    const item=player.attackSlots[index];const values=item.enchantments|| (item.enchantment?[item.enchantment]:[]);
    return values.slice(0,1).map(value=>typeof value==='object'?{...value}:value);
  });
  result={...result,level:result.level||1,isSynergy:true,consumedWeaponIds:[...choice.recipe.ingredients]};
  // Draw the first MAX ingredient last, so it is on top of the crossing.
  const earliest=choice.slots.map(index=>player.attackSlots[index]).sort((a,b)=>(a.maxedOrder??Infinity)-(b.maxedOrder??Infinity))[0];
  result.synergyTopWeaponId=earliest.id;
  if(enchantments.length)result.enchantments=enchantments;
  player.attackSlots[a]=result;player.attackSlots[b]=null;
  return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${result.name||result.id} created!`};
}

import { createBuffHud } from './buff-hud.js';

/** Reserve only visible caption ink, accounting for the slot art's top padding. */
export function levelCaptionSpacing(slotWidth, text) {
  const glyphs = [...text].filter(letter => letter !== ' ').map(glyphRectangle);
  const textWidth = [...text].reduce((sum, letter) => sum +
    (letter === ' ' ? 3 : glyphRectangle(letter).width - 1), 1);
  const inkBottom = Math.max(...glyphs.map(glyph => glyph.offsetY + glyph.height));
  const nextBoxInset = slotWidth * (1 - 237 / 255) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, slotWidth * 0.9 * inkBottom / textWidth - 6 - nextBoxInset);
}

/** Keep the equipment frame 2px below the lowest visible attack-level outline. */
function updateCaptionRowSpacing(container, entries) {
  const visible=entries.filter(entry=>!entry.caption.hidden);
  if(!visible.length){container.style.setProperty('--level-space','0px');return;}
  const textWidth=text=>[...text].reduce((sum,letter)=>sum+(letter===' '?3:glyphRectangle(letter).width-1),1);
  // Scale the entire row together. Fitting each label independently makes LV1 and LV7
  // different heights because their digit glyphs have different widths.
  const scale=Math.min(...visible.map(entry=>entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width*.9/textWidth(entry.captionText)));
  let spacing = 0;
  for (const entry of visible) {
    entry.caption.style.width=`${textWidth(entry.captionText)*scale}px`;
    entry.caption.style.height=`${20*scale}px`;
    const inkBottom=Math.max(...[...entry.captionText].filter(letter=>letter!==' ').map(letter=>{
      const glyph=glyphRectangle(letter);return glyph.offsetY+glyph.height;
    }));
    const nextBoxInset=entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width*(1-237/255)/2;
    spacing=Math.max(spacing,inkBottom*scale-6-nextBoxInset);
  }
  container.style.setProperty('--level-space', `${spacing}px`);
}

import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';
import { mapSizeMultiplier } from './map-bounds.js';
// EDIT zoom and source-pixel polygons to tune this finite, angled map.
export const islandScale = 2 * mapSizeMultiplier; // Map and obstacle geometry scale together.
export const islandWidth = 1448 * islandScale;
export const islandHeight = 1086 * islandScale;
// Inner seawall/paving edge, including the concave inlet on the south side.
export const islandBoundary = [
  [154,309], [267,235], [506,145], [650,145],
  // Follow the recessed north seawall behind the tower instead of cutting
  // straight across the ocean to the right-hand promenade.
  [770,200], [895,176], [1096,145],
  [1277,345], [1392,502], [1320,671], [1055,822],
  [981,704], [781,756], [576,851], [208,764], [59,540]
];
const shoreClearance = 10; // EDIT extra safety distance from water in source pixels.

// Buildings follow their angled footprints. The center tower has only a LOW
// ground footprint here, leaving its visually tall roof/back projection walkable.
export const islandObstacles = [
  [[235,290],[330,230],[430,290],[440,375],[340,415],[255,370]],
  [[400,210],[490,170],[575,220],[585,300],[475,340],[420,305]],
  [[230,470],[305,455],[425,535],[410,605],[270,650],[215,570]],
  [[1010,275],[1090,240],[1170,315],[1180,380],[1070,420],[1000,365]],
  [[1110,460],[1190,420],[1260,485],[1250,555],[1155,600],[1090,545]],
  [[650,398],[730,375],[775,445],[722,490],[650,460]], // Tower foundation only.
  // Pond and its raised rim, following the angled oval in the map artwork.
  Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => [
    890 + 54 * Math.cos(i * Math.PI / 12),
    300 + 43 * Math.sin(i * Math.PI / 12)
  ]),
  // Requested large southwest lawn: follow the curb around the grass/trees.
  [[456,688],[472,637],[551,603],[672,722],[538,786]],
  // Requested triangular planted patch southeast of the center tower.
  [[908,550],[923,520],[980,498],[1048,577],[1038,596]],
];

const towerSilhouette = [[653,144],[692,70],[758,93],[768,438],[724,484],[652,450]];

/** Test source-space points against an angled polygon. */
export function pointInPolygon(x,y,polygon) {
  let inside=false;
  for(let i=0,j=polygon.length-1;i<polygon.length;j=i++) {
    const [xi,yi]=polygon[i], [xj,yj]=polygon[j];
    if((yi>y)!==(yj>y) && x<(xj-xi)*(y-yi)/(yj-yi)+xi) inside=!inside;
  }
  return inside;
}

/** Reject any obstacle intersecting the actor's source-space foot rectangle. */
function intersectsBox(polygon,left,top,right,bottom) {
  if([[left,top],[right,top],[right,bottom],[left,bottom]].some(([x,y])=>pointInPolygon(x,y,polygon)))return true;
  if(polygon.some(([x,y])=>x>=left&&x<=right&&y>=top&&y<=bottom))return true;
  for(let i=0;i<polygon.length;i++) {
    const [x,y]=polygon[i], [xx,yy]=polygon[(i+1)%polygon.length];
    // Parametric clipping of each polygon edge against the rectangle.
    let enter=0,exit=1;
    for(const [p,q]of [[-(xx-x),x-left],[xx-x,right-x],[-(yy-y),y-top],[yy-y,bottom-y]]) {
      if(p===0){if(q<0){enter=2;break;}}else if(p<0)enter=Math.max(enter,q/p);else exit=Math.min(exit,q/p);
    }
    if(enter<=exit)return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Keep foot corners safely inside the paving, away from the sea-facing wall. */
function insideShore(x, y) {
  if (!pointInPolygon(x, y, islandBoundary)) return false;
  for (let i = 0; i < islandBoundary.length; i++) {
    const [ax, ay] = islandBoundary[i];
    const [bx, by] = islandBoundary[(i + 1) % islandBoundary.length];
    const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay;
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((x - ax) * dx + (y - ay) * dy) / (dx * dx + dy * dy)));
    if (Math.hypot(x - ax - t * dx, y - ay - t * dy) < shoreClearance) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/** Keep an entire ground-loot footprint on paving and outside obstacle polygons. */
export function canPlaceIslandLoot(x, y, radius, map) {
  const sx = (x - map.originX) / islandScale, sy = (y - map.originY) / islandScale;
  const r = radius / islandScale;
  return [[sx-r,sy-r],[sx+r,sy-r],[sx+r,sy+r],[sx-r,sy+r]].every(([px,py]) => insideShore(px,py)) &&
    !islandObstacles.some(polygon => intersectsBox(polygon, sx-r, sy-r, sx+r, sy+r));
}

/** Validate island containment and all obstacle footprints at an actor location. */
export function canStandOnIsland(character,x,y,map,ignoreObstacles=false) {
  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
  const sx=(x-map.originX)/islandScale;
  const sy=(y+size/2-spriteDisplayPadding-map.originY)/islandScale;
  const rx=size*.12/islandScale, ry=size*.05/islandScale;
  const corners=[[sx-rx,sy-ry],[sx+rx,sy-ry],[sx+rx,sy+ry],[sx-rx,sy+ry]];
  return corners.every(([x,y])=>insideShore(x,y)) &&
    (ignoreObstacles || !islandObstacles.some(p=>intersectsBox(p,sx-rx,sy-ry,sx+rx,sy+ry)));
}

/** Find nearby boundary tangents for natural sliding along sloped collision edges. */
function contactTangents(character, x, y, map, ignoreObstacles = false) {
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const px = (x - map.originX) / islandScale;
  const py = (y + size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - map.originY) / islandScale;
  const reach = Math.hypot(size * .12, size * .05) / islandScale + shoreClearance + 6;
  const tangents = [];
  for (const polygon of ignoreObstacles ? [islandBoundary] : [islandBoundary, ...islandObstacles]) {
    for (let i = 0; i < polygon.length; i++) {
      const [ax, ay] = polygon[i];
      const [bx, by] = polygon[(i + 1) % polygon.length];
      const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay;
      const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((px - ax) * dx + (py - ay) * dy) / (length * length)));
      if (Math.hypot(px - ax - t * dx, py - ay - t * dy) <= reach) {
        tangents.push([dx / length, dy / length]);
      }
    }
  }
  return tangents;
}

/** Sweep to contact, then project remaining motion onto the actual angled edge. */
export function resolveIslandMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, map, ignoreObstacles = false) {
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.max(Math.abs(toX - fromX), Math.abs(toY - fromY)) / 6));
  const dx = (toX - fromX) / steps, dy = (toY - fromY) / steps;
  let x = fromX, y = fromY;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    if (canStandOnIsland(character, x + dx, y + dy, map, ignoreObstacles)) {
      x += dx; y += dy;
      continue;
    }
    // Reach the edge without crossing it; keep the unapplied movement for sliding.
    let low = 0, high = 1;
    for (let iteration = 0; iteration < 10; iteration++) {
      const fraction = (low + high) / 2;
      if (canStandOnIsland(character, x + dx * fraction, y + dy * fraction, map, ignoreObstacles)) low = fraction;
      else high = fraction;
    }
    x += dx * low; y += dy * low;
    const remainingX = dx * (1 - low), remainingY = dy * (1 - low);
    const candidates = [[remainingX, 0], [0, remainingY]];
    for (const [tx, ty] of contactTangents(character, x, y, map, ignoreObstacles)) {
      const along = remainingX * tx + remainingY * ty;
      candidates.push([tx * along, ty * along]);
    }
    let best = [0, 0], bestProgress = 0;
    for (const [sx, sy] of candidates) {
      const progress = sx * remainingX + sy * remainingY;
      if (progress > bestProgress && canStandOnIsland(character, x + sx, y + sy, map, ignoreObstacles)) {
        best = [sx, sy]; bestProgress = progress;
      }
    }
    x += best[0]; y += best[1];
  }
  return { x, y };
}

/** Draw the entire finite image once; the camera zooms into this world-sized map. */
export function drawIsland(context,map,camera,debug=false) {
  context.drawImage(map.image,map.originX-camera.x,map.originY-camera.y,islandWidth,islandHeight);
  if(debug) {
    context.save();context.strokeStyle='#ffcf60';context.lineWidth=2;
    for(const polygon of [islandBoundary,...islandObstacles]) {
      context.beginPath();polygon.forEach(([x,y],i)=>{
        const args=[map.originX+x*islandScale-camera.x,map.originY+y*islandScale-camera.y];
        if(i===0)context.moveTo(...args);else context.lineTo(...args);
      });context.closePath();context.stroke();
    }context.restore();
  }
}

/** Occlude a behind-tower actor only inside its sprite area and the tower silhouette. */
export function drawTowerOcclusion(context,character,map,camera,opacity=1) {
  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
  const foot=(character.y+size/2-spriteDisplayPadding-map.originY)/islandScale;
  if(foot>=440)return;
  context.save();
    context.globalAlpha *= opacity;
  context.beginPath();context.rect(character.x-camera.x-size/2,character.y-camera.y-size/2,size,size);context.clip();
  context.beginPath();towerSilhouette.forEach(([x,y],i)=>{
    const args=[map.originX+x*islandScale-camera.x,map.originY+y*islandScale-camera.y];
    if(i===0)context.moveTo(...args);else context.lineTo(...args);
  });context.closePath();context.clip();
  drawIsland(context,map,camera);context.restore();
}

import { weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {applySkillControl} from './enemy-control.js';
export function knockbackTuningMultiplier(player){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  return main==='plana-umbrella'&&player.tuningParts?1+tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackStrengthPercent')/100:1;
}
export function applyTuningKnockback(player,enemy){
  if(!enemy||enemy.hp<=0||!player.tuningParts||knockbackTuningMultiplier(player)===1)return false;
  const frames=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackFrames'),speed=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackSpeed');
  if(!frames||!speed)return false;
  const dx=enemy.x-player.x,dy=enemy.y-player.y,length=Math.hypot(dx,dy),distance=speed*frames*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player);
  applySkillControl(enemy,(length?dx/length:1)*distance,(length?dy/length:0)*distance,0,frames/60);
  return true;
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Game/knockback.js | sha256=9c7ac14946f4f7aa77ee52b5e3afe2fec18adf13516acc17b3a31a379ffeef2e | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { knockbackSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Age resistance in gameplay seconds, retaining any configured base resistance. */
export function updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, delta) {
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds === undefined) return;
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds += Math.max(0, delta);
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds >= knockbackSettings.resetSeconds - 1e-8) enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
}

/** Scale speed by existing resistance, then add a stack for subsequent knockbacks. */
export function beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, duration, { ignoreKnockbackResistance = false } = {}) {
  // Absolute immunity also blocks attacks that bypass resistance.
  if (enemy.knockbackImmune || !(duration > 0) || !(Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 0)) return null;
  updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, 0);
  const resistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
  const scale = ignoreKnockbackResistance ? 1 : 1 - resistance;
  enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.round(((enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0) + knockbackSettings.resistancePerHit) * 1e6) / 1e6);
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus);
  return { dx: dx * scale, dy: dy * scale, duration, elapsed: 0, applied: 0, stopped: false };
}

/** Stop displacement without removing an independent stun or contact recovery timer. */
export function stopEnemyKnockback(enemy) {
  if (enemy.skillKnockback) enemy.skillKnockback.stopped = true;
  if (enemy.contactReaction) enemy.contactReaction.stopped = true;
}

/** Travel at constant effect speed until duration expires or the mover reports collision. */
export function advanceKnockback(enemy, motion, delta, move) {
  motion.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
  const progress = Math.min(1, motion.elapsed / motion.duration);
  const step = progress - motion.applied;
  if (!motion.stopped && step > 0 && move(enemy, motion.dx * step, motion.dy * step) === false) motion.stopped = true;
  motion.applied = progress;
  return !motion.stopped && progress < 1;
}

/** Sweep living enemies and sample solid scenery; never slide or pass through a collision. */
export function createKnockbackMover(getEnemies, isClear) {
  return (enemy, dx, dy) => {
    const start = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
    const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (!length) return true;
    const candidates = getEnemies().filter(other => other !== enemy && (!enemy.id || other.id !== enemy.id))
      .map(other => ({ other, body: getCombatHitbox(other, true) }))
      .filter(({ body }) => Math.abs(body.x - start.x) <= Math.abs(dx) + body.rx + start.rx &&
        Math.abs(body.y - start.y) <= Math.abs(dy) + body.ry + start.ry);
    const stepSize = Math.max(.25, Math.min(knockbackSettings.collisionStep, start.rx / 2, start.ry / 2));
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(length / stepSize));
    const stepX = dx / steps, stepY = dy / steps;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
      const x = enemy.x + stepX, y = enemy.y + stepY;
      const body = getCombatHitbox({ ...enemy, x, y }, true);
      const previous = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
      const hit = candidates.find(({ body: other }) => segmentHitsBody({ ...other,
        rx: other.rx + body.rx, ry: other.ry + body.ry }, previous.x, previous.y, body.x, body.y));
      if (hit || !isClear(enemy, x, y)) {
        stopEnemyKnockback(enemy);
        if (hit) stopEnemyKnockback(hit.other);
        return false;
      }
      enemy.x = x; enemy.y = y;
    }
    return true;
  };
}

--- SNAPSHOT FILE: public/Game/level-up-actions.js | sha256=20a58d58145c8ac40c9ff075abdea41e5854f8fa5b70533587bafeb3f13227da | encoding=utf-8-sig ---
import { isContentUnlocked } from './item-catalog.js';
const limits={reroll:10,eliminate:10,hold:5};
export function levelActionUses(player,action){
  const purchased=Math.max(0,Math.min(limits[action],Math.trunc(Number(player.abilityUpgradeRanks?.[action])||0)));
  const granted=isContentUnlocked('developer-level-actions')?limits[action]:purchased;
  return Math.max(0,granted-(player.levelActionSpent?.[action]||0));
}
export function spendLevelAction(player,action){
  if(!levelActionUses(player,action))return false;
  player.levelActionSpent??={};player.levelActionSpent[action]=(player.levelActionSpent[action]||0)+1;return true;
}
export function levelActionChoices(player,pool,random=Math.random){
  const remaining=pool.slice(),choices=[];
  while(remaining.length){
    const weight=choice=>Math.max(0,Number(choice.weapon?.weight??1)||0),total=remaining.reduce((sum,c)=>sum+weight(c),0);
    let roll=random()*total,index=remaining.length-1;
    for(let i=0;i<remaining.length;i++){roll-=weight(remaining[i]);if(roll<0){index=i;break;}}
    choices.push(...remaining.splice(index,1));
  }
  const held=choices.findIndex(choice=>choice.id===player.heldUpgradeId);
  if(held>=0)choices.unshift(...choices.splice(held,1));
  return choices;
}

  }
  const textRenderers = new WeakMap();
  const observers = new Map();

  /** Create accessible, wrapped sprite-font copy with consistent baselines. */
  function text(element, value, scale = 1.2) {
    let renderer = textRenderers.get(element);
    if (!renderer) {
      const graphic = document.createElement('canvas');
      element.replaceChildren(graphic);
      renderer = createBitmapText(graphic, { variant: 'font2', scale, outlineOverlap: 1,
        maxWidth: Math.max(1, element.clientWidth || 400), wrap: element.tagName === 'P' });
      textRenderers.set(element, renderer);

    }
    if (!observers.has(element)) {
      const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        if(element.classList.contains('level-up-description'))fitUpgradeDescription(element,renderer,element.firstElementChild,scale);
        else renderer.setMaxWidth(Math.max(1,element.clientWidth));
      });
      observer.observe(element); observers.set(element, observer);
    }
    renderer.setText(value);
    if(element.classList.contains('level-up-description'))fitUpgradeDescription(element,renderer,element.firstElementChild,scale);
  }

  /** Highlight/focus a choice, supporting mouse and keyboard equally. */
  function select(index, focus = true) {
    if (!choices.length) { continueButton.focus({ preventScroll: true }); return; }
    selected = (index + choices.length) % choices.length;
    [...choicesElement.children].forEach((button, i) => {
      button.classList.toggle('selected', i === selected);
      button.tabIndex = i === selected ? 0 : -1;
    });
    if (focus) choicesElement.children[selected]?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  /** Apply once, then show the next queued level or return control to gameplay. */
  function choose(index) {
    if(!player||!choices[index])return;
    if(actionMode){
      if(!spendLevelAction(player,actionMode))return;
      const choice=choices[index];
      if(actionMode==='eliminate'){
        player.eliminatedUpgradeIds??=[];player.eliminatedUpgradeIds.push(choice.weapon?.id||choice.id);
        if(player.heldUpgradeId===choice.id)delete player.heldUpgradeId;
      }else{
        player.heldUpgradeId=choice.id;player.pendingUpgrades--;onChoose(player);
      }
      actionMode=null;if(player.pendingUpgrades>0)render();else close();return;
    }
    delete player.heldUpgradeId;
    if(!applyLevelUpgrade(player,choices[index].id))return;
    onChoose(player);
    if (player.pendingUpgrades > 0) render();
    else close();
  }

  /** Render character stats and a fresh choice set for one earned level. */
  function render() {
    for (const observer of observers.values()) observer.disconnect();
    observers.clear();
    text(document.querySelector('#level-up-title'), 'LEVEL UP!', 2);
    text(document.querySelector('#level-up-help'), 'Choose an upgrade to continue. Up / Down to select, Enter to confirm.', .9);
    text(document.querySelector('#level-up-name'), player.label, 1.3);
    const earnedLevel = player.level - player.pendingUpgrades + 1;
    text(document.querySelector('#level-up-progress'), `Level ${earnedLevel} - Choose an upgrade`, 1.1);
    const portrait = document.querySelector('#level-up-portrait');
    const label = player.label.toLowerCase();
    const source = label.includes('plana') ? '../sprites/Plana_Portrait.png'
      : label.includes('arona') ? '../sprites/Arona_Portrait.png' : '';
    portrait.hidden = !source;
    if (source) portrait.src = source;
    const stats = document.querySelector('#level-up-stats');
    stats.replaceChildren();
    for (const [name, icon, value] of statRows) {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'level-up-stat';
      const image = document.createElement('img'); image.src = `../sprites/icons/${icon}`; image.alt = '';
      const nameElement = document.createElement('span'), valueElement = document.createElement('span');
      row.append(image, nameElement, valueElement); stats.append(row);
      text(nameElement, name, 1); text(valueElement, value(player), 1);
    }
    choices = levelActionChoices(player,rollLevelUpgrades(player,{all:true})).slice(0,levelUpgradeSettings.choices);
    choicesElement.replaceChildren();
    continueButton.hidden = choices.length > 0;
    if (!choices.length) text(document.querySelector('#level-up-help'), 'No upgrades available. Continue to resume.', .9);
    text(continueButton, 'Continue', 1.2);
    const weapon = getUmbrella(player) || getArisWeapon(player);
    const displayed = choices.length ? choices : weapon ? [{ name: `${weapon.name || "Weapon"} - MAX`, weapon,
      category: weapon.awakened ? 'Awakened' : 'LV 7',
      description: weapon.awakened ? 'This weapon is fully awakened.' : 'Maximum level reached. Collect a Secret Tech Note to awaken it.' }] : [];
    displayed.forEach((upgrade, index) => {
      const button = document.createElement('button');
      button.type = 'button'; button.className = 'level-up-choice';
      const rewardCategory = String(upgrade.category || '').toLowerCase();
      button.setAttribute('data-upgrade-kind', rewardCategory.includes('skill') ? 'skill' : rewardCategory.includes('item') || rewardCategory.includes('equipment') ? 'item' : 'weapon');
      button.setAttribute('aria-label', `${upgrade.name}. ${upgrade.description}`);
      const header = document.createElement('div'); header.className = 'level-up-choice-header';
      const title = document.createElement('span'), category = document.createElement('span');
      header.append(title, category);
      const body = document.createElement('div'); body.className = 'level-up-choice-body';
      const icon = document.createElement('canvas'); icon.width = icon.height = 128;
      icon.className = 'level-up-weapon-icon';
      if(upgrade.weapon.iconFit)icon.setAttribute('data-icon-fit','true');
      applyEnhancedWeaponGlow(icon,upgrade.weapon);
      icon.setAttribute('aria-label', upgrade.weapon.name || upgrade.name);
      if (upgrade.weapon.awakened || upgrade.id?.endsWith('-awaken')) icon.classList.add('awakened-icon');
      const image = new Image();
      image.onload = () => {
        if(drawSynergyIcon(icon,upgrade.weapon))return;
        const crop = upgrade.weapon.iconCrop || { x: 0, y: 0, width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight };
        const context = icon.getContext('2d');
        const angle = (upgrade.weapon.iconRotation || 0) * Math.PI / 180;
        context.translate(64, 64); if(upgrade.weapon.iconFlipX)context.scale(-1,1); context.rotate(angle);
        const width = Math.abs(crop.width * Math.cos(angle)) + Math.abs(crop.height * Math.sin(angle));
        const height = Math.abs(crop.width * Math.sin(angle)) + Math.abs(crop.height * Math.cos(angle));
        const scale = (upgrade.weapon.iconFit?124:120) / Math.max(width, height);
        context.drawImage(image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
          -crop.width*scale/2, -crop.height*scale/2, crop.width*scale, crop.height*scale);
      };
      image.src = upgrade.weapon.icon;
      const description = document.createElement('p');description.className='level-up-description';
      body.append(icon, description); button.append(header, body); choicesElement.append(button);
      text(title, upgrade.name, 1.3); text(category, upgrade.category, 1); text(description, upgrade.description, 1.2);
      button.disabled = !choices.length;
      button.addEventListener('click', () => choose(index));
      button.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => select(index, false));
    });
    for (let i = displayed.length; i < levelUpgradeSettings.choices; i++) {
      const empty = document.createElement('div'); empty.className = 'level-up-empty-slot';
      empty.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); choicesElement.append(empty);
    }
    updateActions();select(0);
  }

  /** Restore developer controls only after the final queued level has been resolved. */
  function close() {
    player = null; actionMode=null; overlay.hidden = true;
    for (const observer of observers.values()) observer.disconnect();
    observers.clear();
    for (const [element, inert] of previousInert) element.inert = inert;
    previousInert = [];
    releaseControls(); canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  continueButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!player || choices.length) return;
    player.pendingUpgrades = 0;
    onChoose(player); close();
  });
  overlay.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault());
  overlay.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
    if (event.button === 2) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (!player || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.altKey) return;
    if(!overlay.contains?.(event.target))return;
    if(event.target?.closest?.('input, select, textarea, [contenteditable="true"]'))return;
    if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'w', 's', 'Enter', ' ', 'Escape'].includes(event.key)) {
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      if (event.repeat) return;
      if(event.key==='Escape'){actionMode=null;updateActions();text(document.querySelector('#level-up-help'),'Choose an upgrade to continue.',.9);return;}
      if(['Enter',' '].includes(event.key)&&event.target?.closest?.('.level-up-actions')){event.target.closest('button')?.click();return;}
      if (['ArrowUp', 'w'].includes(event.key)) select(selected - 1);
      if (['ArrowDown', 's'].includes(event.key)) select(selected + 1);
      if (['Enter', ' '].includes(event.key)) {
        if (choices.length) choose(selected); else continueButton.click();
      }
    }
  }, true);

  return {
    get active() { return player !== null; },
    update() {
      if (player || isPauseMenuOpen() || !(getPlayer().pendingUpgrades > 0)) return;
      player = getPlayer();
      releaseControls(); onOpen(); overlay.hidden = false;
      // Keep admin tools and the rest of the browser usable during upgrade selection.
      previousInert = [[canvas,canvas.inert]];
      canvas.inert = true;
      render();
    }
  };
}

/** Offer only the next upgrade for an equipped, implemented weapon. */
function umbrellaChoices(player) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const weapon = getUmbrella(player);
  if (!weapon) return [];
  const level = weapon.level || 1;
  if (level < umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel) return [{ id: 'umbrella-level',
    name: `Plana's Umbrella ${upgradeLevelLabel(weapon,umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel)}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon', description: descriptions[level + 1] }];
  return [];
}

}

/** Advance one weapon level; awakening is available only through a Crafter. */
export function applyLevelUpgrade(player, id) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  if (player.pendingUpgrades <= 0 || !rollLevelUpgrades(player,{all:true}).some(choice => choice.id === id)) return false;
  if(id.startsWith('phrenapates-')||id.startsWith('celestia-')||id.startsWith('swipe-')){if(!applyCharacterSkillUpgrade(player,id))return false;player.pendingUpgrades--;return true;}
  if(id==='bayonet-new'||id==='bayonet-level'){
    player.attackSlots??=[];

import { lifeJacketStats, syncLifeJacketShield } from './item-catalog.js';
/** Timers use gameplay seconds. Full-shield healing requires three continuous full seconds. */
export function updateLifeJacket(player,delta){
 syncLifeJacketShield(player);const stats=lifeJacketStats(player),state=player.lifeJacketState;
 if(!stats||!state||!(delta>0))return;
 let left=delta;
 while(left>1e-8){
  const full=state.remaining>=state.capacity-1e-8;
  if(!full||!stats.super)state.healElapsed=0;
  const step=Math.min(left,15-state.refreshElapsed,stats.super&&full?3-state.healElapsed:Infinity);
  left-=step;state.refreshElapsed+=step;if(stats.super&&full)state.healElapsed+=step;
  if(state.refreshElapsed>=15-1e-8){state.remaining=state.capacity;state.refreshElapsed=0;}
  if(stats.super&&full&&state.healElapsed>=3-1e-8){player.hp=Math.min(player.maxHp,player.hp+10);state.healElapsed=0;}
 }
}

import { syncRacerPassHealth, syncLifeJacketShield, updateSportsDrink } from './item-catalog.js';

/** Repeat equip clicks level owned basic weapons; never awaken or enhance them. */
export function equipAdminWeapon(player,createWeapon){
  const candidate=createWeapon(),slots=player.attackSlots??=[],owned=slots.find(w=>w?.id===candidate.id);
  if(owned){
    const maximum=owned.isSynergy?1:(owned.maxLevel??candidate.maxLevel??7);
    const next=Math.min(maximum,(owned.level||1)+1);
    if(next>(owned.level||1)){owned.level=next;recordWeaponMax(player,owned);}
    return true;
  }
  const empty=slots.findIndex(w=>!w);
  if(empty>=0)slots[empty]=candidate;else if(slots.length<6)slots.push(candidate);else return false;
  recordWeaponMax(player,candidate);return true;
}
/** Manual equips bypass reward unlocks without permanently unlocking items. */
export function equipAdminItem(player,item){
  const slots=player.equipmentSlots??=[],owned=slots.findIndex(owned=>owned?.id===item.id),empty=slots.findIndex(owned=>!owned);
  const index=owned>=0?owned:empty>=0?empty:slots.length;
  if(index>=6)return false;
  const current=owned>=0?slots[owned]:null;
  if(current&&!item.isSuper&&!item.awakened){
    if(!current.isSuper&&!current.awakened){
      const maximum=current.maxLevel??item.maxLevel??3;
      if((current.level||1)<maximum)current.level=(current.level||1)+1;
      else if(item.id==='sports-drink')slots[index]=createSportsDrink(true);
      else if(item.id==='malkuth-hat')slots[index]=createMalkuthHat(true);
      else if(item.id==='racer-pass')slots[index]=createRacerPass(true);
      else if(item.id==='safety-helmet')slots[index]=createSafetyHelmet(true);
      else if(item.id==='life-jacket')slots[index]=createLifeJacket(true);
      else if(item.id==='overheated-overclocking')slots[index]=createOverheatedOverclocking(true);
    }
  }else if(!current||!current.isSuper&&!current.awakened){slots[index]={...item};}
  return true;
}
export function createItemEquipAdmin({root,getPlayer,onChange=()=>{}}){
  const status=document.createElement('p');status.className='admin-equip-status';status.setAttribute('role','status');
  const options=[
    {label:"Equip Sports Drink",create:()=>createSportsDrink()},
    {label:"Equip Malkuth's Hat",create:()=>createMalkuthHat()},
    {label:'Equip Racer Pass',create:()=>createRacerPass()},
    {label:'Equip Safety Helmet',create:()=>createSafetyHelmet()},
    {label:'Equip Life Jacket',create:()=>createLifeJacket()},
    {label:'Equip Chise Plushie',create:()=>createChisePlushie()},
    {label:'Equip Special Pharmaceuticals',create:()=>createSpecialPharmaceuticals()},
    {label:'Equip Overheated Overclocking',create:()=>createOverheatedOverclocking()}
  ];
  for(const option of options){
    const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.textContent=option.label;button.title='Equip, level up, then click once more at MAX for its defined Super/Awakened form.';
    button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      const player=getPlayer(),item=option.create();
      if(!equipAdminItem(player,item)){status.textContent='No empty equipment slot available.';return;}
      const equipped=player.equipmentSlots.find(owned=>owned?.id===item.id);
      onChange(player);status.textContent=`${equipped.name} ${equipped.isSuper||equipped.awakened?'Super / Awakened':equipped.level>=equipped.maxLevel?'MAX':`LV ${equipped.level}`} equipped.`;
    });root.append(button);
  }
  const hint=document.createElement('p');hint.textContent="Malkuth's Hat unlock: defeat Arisu. Racer Pass is unlocked by default. Admin equips bypass locks.";
  root.append(hint,status);
}

import { itemSkillDamageMultiplier } from './item-catalog.js';

const buffKey='luminous-nova-ex';

/** Banked bonus only: no extra ATK or critical roll can exceed this component's cap. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherDamage(damageDealt,player) {
  const baseAttack=damageRules.baseScale*totalCharacterATK(player)/100;
  return Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.round(damageDealt*skill.damageFraction*itemSkillDamageMultiplier(player)),Math.floor(baseAttack*skill.attackCapMultiplier)));
}

/** Nominal281% ATK before the normal damage roll; the banked extra is calculated separately. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherBaseDamage(player) {
  return Math.max(0,Math.round(damageRules.baseScale*skill.finisherAttackMultiplier*totalCharacterATK(player)/100*itemSkillDamageMultiplier(player)));
}

/** Own the25s aura, temporary stats, accepted-damage bank and charged finishing shot. */
export function createLuminousNovaSkill({random=Math.random}={}) {
  let state=null;
  const image=new Image();image.src='../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Kei.png';const ready=image.decode();
  function removeBuff(){if(state?.owner.combatBuffs)delete state.owner.combatBuffs[buffKey];}
  function reset(){removeBuff();state=null;}
  const unsubscribe=onEnemyDamage(({source,damage,triggersSkills})=>{
    if(triggersSkills===false)return;
    if(state?.phase==='aura'&&source===state.owner&&Number.isFinite(damage))state.damageDealt+=Math.max(0,damage);
  });
  function cast(player,angle,getAngle=()=>angle) {
    reset();player.combatBuffs??={};
    player.combatBuffs[buffKey]={damageBonusMultiplier:skill.damageBonus,critPercent:skill.critBonus};
    const turn=value=>player.tuningParts?startingWeaponAim(player,'luminous-nova',value):value;
    state={owner:player,phase:'aura',elapsed:0,damageDealt:0,angle:turn(angle),getAngle:()=>turn(getAngle()),hits:new Set()};
  }
  /** Advance on simulation time only, so menus freeze both the buff and the charge. */
  function update(delta,player) {
    if(!state)return;
    if(state.owner!==player||!getLuminousNova(player)){reset();return;}
    let remaining=Math.max(0,delta);
    while(state&&remaining>1e-8) {
      const duration=state.phase==='aura'?skill.duration:state.phase==='opening'?skill.openingSeconds:
        state.phase==='charge'?skill.chargeSeconds:skill.projectileSeconds;
      const step=Math.min(remaining,Math.max(0,duration-state.elapsed));state.elapsed+=step;remaining-=step;
      if(state.burst)state.burst.elapsed+=step;
      if(state.phase==='opening'||state.phase==='charge')state.angle=state.getAngle();
      if(state.phase==='firing') {
        const from={x:state.x,y:state.y};
        state.x+=Math.cos(state.launchAngle)*skill.projectileSpeed*step;
        state.y+=Math.sin(state.launchAngle)*skill.projectileSpeed*step;
        for(const target of getAllEnemies()) {
          if(state.hits.has(target.id)||!luminousNovaHits(target,from,state,skill.projectileDiameter/2*luminousNovaSettings.bloomRadiusScale))continue;
          state.hits.add(target.id);

          damageEnemy(target.id,hit.damage,state.owner,hit.type);
        }
      }
      if(state.elapsed<duration-1e-8)break;
      if(state.phase==='aura') {
        removeBuff();state.damage=luminousNovaFinisherDamage(state.damageDealt,player);state.phase='opening';state.elapsed=0;
        const center=getCombatHitbox(player,false);state.burst={x:center.x,y:center.y,elapsed:0};
        // Release the stored charge radially; it is separate from the aimed281% ATK bullet.
        if(state.damage>0)for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
          const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
          if(Math.hypot(body.x-center.x,body.y-center.y)<=skill.aoeRadius+Math.max(body.rx,body.ry))
            damageEnemy(enemy.id,state.damage,player,'normal');
        }
      } else if(state.phase==='opening'){state.phase='charge';state.elapsed=0;}
      else if(state.phase==='charge') {
        const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),distance=body.rx+skill.muzzleGap+skill.projectileFormationGap;
        state.angle=state.getAngle();state.launchAngle=state.angle;state.projectileActive=true;
        state.x=body.x+Math.cos(state.angle)*distance;state.y=body.y+Math.sin(state.angle)*distance;
        state.launchX=state.x;state.launchY=state.y;
        state.phase='firing';state.elapsed=0;
      } else reset();
    }
  }
  /** Preview the finisher radius and remaining aura time beneath rising potion-like motes. */
  function drawAura(context,camera) {
    if(!state||state.phase!=='aura')return;

    context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,skill.aoeRadius*remaining,0,Math.PI*2);context.stroke();
    // Spread a small, fixed number of motes across the range, rising off the overlay.
    // Staggered lifetimes avoid bursts; transparent gradients avoid expensive blur filters.
    context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    for(let i=0;i<28;i++) {
      const lifetime=1.8+(i%5)*.23;
      const t=(state.elapsed/lifetime+i*.61803398875)%1;
      const angle=i*2.39996323;
      const distance=skill.aoeRadius*Math.sqrt((i+.5)/28);

      const y=Math.sin(angle)*distance-t*28;
      const radius=(1.3+(i%3)*.45)*(1-t*.5);
      context.globalAlpha=fade*Math.sin(Math.PI*t)*.42;

      context.globalAlpha=fade*Math.sin(Math.PI*t)*.7;

      glow.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,235,253,.95)');glow.addColorStop(.3,'rgba(255,145,225,.65)');

    }
    context.restore();
  }
  /** A brief expanding pink ring marks the stored charge's player-centered AoE. */

  }
  /** Fade the gun out from behind the player, charge its muzzle, then retract after firing. */
  function draw(context,camera) {

    const body=getCombatHitbox(state.owner,false),smooth=t=>{t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));return t*t*(3-2*t);};

    if(image.naturalWidth&&progress>0) {

      const targetOffset=body.rx+skill.muzzleGap-skill.weaponLength/2;
      const offset=-skill.weaponLength*.35*(1-progress)+targetOffset*progress,height=skill.weaponLength*image.naturalHeight/image.naturalWidth;
      context.save();context.translate(body.x-camera.x,body.y-camera.y);context.rotate(state.phase==='firing'?state.launchAngle:state.angle);context.globalAlpha=progress;
      context.shadowColor='#ff90de';context.shadowBlur=12;context.drawImage(image,offset-skill.weaponLength/2,-height/2,skill.weaponLength,height);
      if(state.phase==='charge') {
        context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
        const radius=skill.projectileDiameter/2*(.2+.8*smooth(state.elapsed/skill.chargeSeconds));
        const formation=body.rx+skill.muzzleGap+skill.projectileFormationGap;
        const charge=context.createRadialGradient(formation,0,0,formation,0,radius*2);
        charge.addColorStop(0,'#fff4ff');charge.addColorStop(.4,'#ff95dfbb');charge.addColorStop(1,'#ff70d000');context.fillStyle=charge;
        context.beginPath();context.arc(formation,0,radius*2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
        // Deterministic jagged arcs crawl from the gun into its muzzle charge.
        // Two unfiltered strokes supply a bright spine and a soft-looking pink electrical envelope.
        const tick=Math.floor(state.elapsed*18),muzzle=formation;
        context.shadowBlur=0;
        for(let arc=0;arc<5;arc++) {
          const side=arc%2?1:-1,start=muzzle-skill.weaponLength*(.25+.12*arc);
          context.beginPath();context.moveTo(start,side*height*.3);
          for(let segment=1;segment<=7;segment++) {
            const t=segment/7;
            const jitter=Math.sin(tick*7.13+arc*13.7+segment*9.3);
            context.lineTo(start+(muzzle-start)*t,segment===7?0:side*height*.3*(1-t)+jitter*(5+radius*.35));
          }
          context.strokeStyle='rgba(255,90,210,.25)';context.lineWidth=5;context.stroke();
          context.strokeStyle='rgba(255,225,253,.85)';context.lineWidth=1;context.stroke();
        }
      }
      context.restore();
    }
    if(state.phase==='firing'&&state.projectileActive) {
      drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,{...state,rainbow:state.owner.tuningParts?rgbTuningActive(state.owner):false,age:state.elapsed},skill.projectileDiameter,skill.projectileSeconds);
      // Muzzle-anchored impact rings spread into a widening cone, independent of bullet travel.
      const muzzleDistance=body.rx+skill.muzzleGap;
      drawFiringRings(context,body.x-camera.x+Math.cos(state.launchAngle)*muzzleDistance,
        body.y-camera.y+Math.sin(state.launchAngle)*muzzleDistance,state.launchAngle,state.elapsed,skill.projectileDiameter);

    }
  }
  return {ready,cast,update,draw,reset,dispose(){reset();unsubscribe();},
    get auraActive(){return state?.phase==='aura';},
    get active(){return Boolean(state);},get phase(){return state?.phase||'idle';},
    get damageDealt(){return state?.damageDealt||0;},get finisherDamage(){return state?.damage||0;},
    get finishing(){return Boolean(state&&state.phase!=='aura'&&(state.phase!=='firing'||state.elapsed<skill.returnSeconds));}};
}

import { weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import {stationaryWeaponIntervalScale} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {startingWeaponAim} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {rgbTuningActive,rainbowTrailGradient,rainbowPlasmaColor} from './rgb-tuning.js';
import { luminousNovaSettings, attackTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Equip Kei's automatic weapon and its independent aura EX skill. */
export function createLuminousNovaWeapon() {
  return {id:'luminous-nova',name:'Luminous Nova',level:1,maxLevel:luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,
    icon:'../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Kei.png',iconRotation:-45,exSkill:true};
}
export function getLuminousNova(player) {return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon=>weapon?.id==='luminous-nova');}

/** Fire-rate bonuses are absolute multiples of the base cycle, never cumulative multipliers. */
export function luminousNovaLevelStats(player) {
  const level=Math.max(1,Math.min(7,getLuminousNova(player)?.level||1));
  const fireRate=1+Number(level>=3)+Number(level>=5)+Number(level>=7);
  return {level,fireRate,interval:luminousNovaSettings.attackInterval/fireRate,
    damageMultiplier:(level>=2?1.2:1)*(level>=4?1.3:1),knockback:level>=6};
}

/** Damage levels multiply base damage; flat enhancements split over the base-cycle projectile count. */
export function rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random=Math.random,target) {
  const stats=luminousNovaLevelStats(player);
  return rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'luminous-nova',luminousNovaSettings.damageMultiplier,
    [(stats.damageMultiplier-1)*100],{projectileCount:stats.fireRate,hitCooldownFrames:10}),random,{target});
}

/** Sweep the spherical head so fast plasma rounds cannot tunnel past enemies. */
export function luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,to,radius=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter/2*luminousNovaSettings.bloomRadiusScale) {
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,to.x,to.y);
}

/** Independent aimed, unlimited-piercing automatic plasma weapon. */
export function createLuminousNovaAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings;
  let owner=null,cooldown=0,bullets=[],enabled=true,shots=0,skillFinishing=false;
  let stationaryScale=1;
  function reset(){stationaryScale=1;owner=null;cooldown=0;bullets=[];shots=0;}
  function fire(player,aim) {
    const origin=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
    // Follow the shared arrow/crosshair aim and keep that direction throughout this shot.
    const angle=player.tuningParts?startingWeaponAim(player,'luminous-nova',Number.isFinite(aim)?aim:0):(Number.isFinite(aim)?aim:0);
    const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
    const edge=1/Math.hypot(dx/origin.rx,dy/origin.ry);
    const diameter=s.bulletDiameter*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
    const offset=edge+s.muzzleGap+diameter/2*s.bloomRadiusScale;
    if(bullets.length<s.maxProjectiles){bullets.push({x:origin.x+dx*offset,y:origin.y+dy*offset,angle,diameter,rainbowPhase:shots*.618,rainbow:player.tuningParts?rgbTuningActive(player):false,age:0,travel:0,accelerating:true,hits:new Map()});shots++;}
    return true;
  }
  /** Move and expire each shot independently; pierce all targets with a per-shot hit cooldown. */
  function advance(delta,player) {
    for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
      const bullet=bullets[i],step=Math.min(delta,s.duration-bullet.age),from={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y};
      // Integrate the speed ramp analytically so acceleration is independent of frame rate.
      const distanceAt=age=>s.projectileSpeed*(age<s.accelerationSeconds?age*age/(2*s.accelerationSeconds):age-s.accelerationSeconds/2);
      const distance=distanceAt(bullet.age+step)-distanceAt(bullet.age);
      bullet.age+=step;bullet.travel+=distance;
      bullet.x+=Math.cos(bullet.angle)*distance;bullet.y+=Math.sin(bullet.angle)*distance;
      for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
        if(bullet.age-(bullet.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,bullet,(bullet.diameter??s.bulletDiameter)/2*s.bloomRadiusScale))continue;
        bullet.hits.set(enemy.id,bullet.age); // A missed hit cannot retry every frame.
        const hit=rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random,enemy);
        const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});
        const living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
        if(landed!==false&&living&&luminousNovaLevelStats(player).knockback) {
          const distance=s.knockbackSpeed*s.knockbackSeconds*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player);
          applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(bullet.angle)*distance,Math.sin(bullet.angle)*distance,
            s.knockbackSeconds,s.knockbackSeconds);
        }
      }
      if(bullet.age>=s.duration-1e-8)bullets.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
  /** Stagger shots over the2.5s base cycle; Haste changes cadence, not lifetime or hit cooldown. */
  function update(delta,player,aim=0) {
    if(!getLuminousNova(player)){reset();return;}
    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    const intervalScale=player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1;cooldown*=intervalScale/stationaryScale;stationaryScale=intervalScale;
    if(!enabled||delta<=0)return;
    if(skillFinishing){advance(delta,player);return;}
    let remaining=delta;
    while(remaining>1e-8) {
      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
        fire(player,aim);
        cooldown=attackTimeFormula(luminousNovaLevelStats(player).interval*stationaryScale,ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
      }
      const step=Math.min(remaining,cooldown,s.hitCooldown/2);
      advance(step,player);cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);remaining-=step;
    }
  }
  /** Draw every active pink round using the shared spherical plasma renderer. */
  function draw(context,camera) {const rainbow=Boolean(owner?.tuningParts&&rgbTuningActive(owner));for(const bullet of bullets){bullet.rainbow=rainbow;drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,bullet.diameter);}}
  return {getAuraSources(){return bullets;},ready:Promise.resolve(),reset,update,draw,
    setSkillFinishing(value){skillFinishing=Boolean(value);},
    setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled)bullets=[];},
    get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;},get shotsFired(){return shots;}};
}


/** Keep a bounded path for steering projectiles; straight bullets retain their existing renderer. */
export function rememberPlasmaTrail(bullet,from,maxLength) {
  const trail=bullet.trail??=[{x:from.x,y:from.y,distance:0}];
  const last=trail.at(-1),step=Math.hypot(bullet.x-last.x,bullet.y-last.y);
  if(step<.25)return;
  trail.push({x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y,distance:last.distance+step});
  while(trail.length>2&&(trail.at(-1).distance-trail[1].distance>maxLength||trail.length>48))trail.shift();
}

/** Convert actual traveled positions to the plasma head's local coordinates, newest first. */
export function plasmaTrailPoints(bullet,maxLength) {
  if(!(bullet.trail?.length>1)||!(maxLength>1e-8))return null;
  const points=[{x:0,y:0,distance:0}],cos=Math.cos(bullet.angle),sin=Math.sin(bullet.angle);
  let previous={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y},distance=0;
  for(let i=bullet.trail.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=bullet.trail[i],length=Math.hypot(p.x-previous.x,p.y-previous.y);if(length<1e-8)continue;
    const fraction=Math.min(1,(maxLength-distance)/length),x=previous.x+(p.x-previous.x)*fraction,y=previous.y+(p.y-previous.y)*fraction;
    distance+=length*fraction;const dx=x-bullet.x,dy=y-bullet.y;
    points.push({x:dx*cos+dy*sin,y:-dx*sin+dy*cos,distance});
    if(fraction<1||distance>=maxLength)break;previous=p;
  }
  return points.length>1?points:null;
}

/** Shared spherical plasma rendering; the EX changes diameter without changing the normal weapon. */
export function drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter,duration=luminousNovaSettings.duration) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings,radius=diameter/2;
  // Preserve gradient opacity and pale hot highlights while tinting the full plasma effect.
  const tint=value=>{
    if(bullet.rainbow)return rainbowPlasmaColor(value,bullet.age*160+(bullet.rainbowPhase||0)*360);
    if(bullet.color==='orange') {
      const orange=(r,g,b)=>[Number(r),Math.round(80+Number(g)*.60),Math.round(Number(g)*.20)];
      if(value.startsWith('#'))return '#'+orange(parseInt(value.slice(1,3),16),parseInt(value.slice(3,5),16),parseInt(value.slice(5,7),16)).map(n=>n.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
      return value.replace(/(rgba?\()(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/,(_,prefix,r,g,b)=>prefix+orange(r,g,b).join(','));
    }
    return bullet.color!=='blue'?value:value.startsWith('#')
      ? '#'+value.slice(3,5)+value.slice(5,7)+value.slice(1,3)
      : value.replace(/(rgba?\()(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/, '$1$3,$4,$2');
  };
  // Skip the whole effect once both its head and longest wake have left the canvas.
  const reach=radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio+s.bloomRadiusScale);
  const screenX=bullet.x-camera.x,screenY=bullet.y-camera.y;
  if(context.canvas&&(screenX+reach<0||screenY+reach<0||screenX-reach>context.canvas.width||screenY-reach>context.canvas.height))return;
  context.save();context.translate(bullet.x-camera.x,bullet.y-camera.y);context.rotate(bullet.angle);
  const fadeOut=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(duration-bullet.age)/(bullet.fadeOutSeconds??.06)));
  const endOpacity=bullet.fadeOutSeconds?fadeOut*fadeOut*(3-2*fadeOut):fadeOut;
  const fade=endOpacity*Math.min(1,bullet.age/s.fadeInSeconds);
  // Only leave a wake along positions reached after acceleration, never behind the muzzle.
  const wakeAge=bullet.accelerating?Math.max(0,bullet.age-s.accelerationSeconds):bullet.age;
  context.globalAlpha=fade;
  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  // A broad soft halo and a tighter luminous rim keep small shots bright without enlarging their core.
  const halo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*3.6);
  halo.addColorStop(0,tint('rgba(255,225,252,.95)'));halo.addColorStop(.25,tint('rgba(255,125,229,.75)'));
  halo.addColorStop(.55,tint('rgba(244,48,186,.35)'));halo.addColorStop(1,tint('rgba(220,35,180,0)'));
  context.fillStyle=halo;
  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*3.6,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
  context.filter='none';
  const rim=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,radius*.5,0,0,radius*1.6);
  rim.addColorStop(0,tint('rgba(255,224,252,.7)'));rim.addColorStop(.45,tint('rgba(255,99,216,.4)'));rim.addColorStop(1,tint('rgba(255,55,196,0)'));
  context.fillStyle=rim;context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*1.6,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
  const trailLength=Math.min(radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio),(bullet.trailSpeed??bullet.speed??s.projectileSpeed)*wakeAge);
  const path=plasmaTrailPoints(bullet,trailLength),end=path?.at(-1)||{x:-trailLength,y:0};
  const tail=bullet.rainbow?rainbowTrailGradient(context,end.x,end.y,0,0):context.createLinearGradient(end.x,end.y,0,0);
  if(!bullet.rainbow){
  tail.addColorStop(0,tint('rgba(239,61,194,0)'));tail.addColorStop(.15,tint('rgba(255,80,210,.35)'));
  tail.addColorStop(.45,tint('rgba(255,130,230,.75)'));tail.addColorStop(.75,tint('rgba(255,200,248,.95)'));tail.addColorStop(1,tint('#fff5ff'));}
  /** Draw a connected tapered wake behind the spherical head, with a narrow luminous spine. */
  function drawTrail(width) {
    if(path){
      const total=path.at(-1).distance,left=[],right=[];
      for(let i=0;i<path.length;i++){
        const p=path[i],before=path[Math.max(0,i-1)],after=path[Math.min(path.length-1,i+1)];
        const dx=after.x-before.x,dy=after.y-before.y,length=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
        const half=radius*width*(1-p.distance/total);
        left.push({x:p.x-dy/length*half,y:p.y+dx/length*half});right.push({x:p.x+dy/length*half,y:p.y-dx/length*half});
      }
      context.beginPath();context.moveTo(left[0].x,left[0].y);
      for(const p of left.slice(1))context.lineTo(p.x,p.y);
      for(let i=right.length-1;i>=0;i--)context.lineTo(right[i].x,right[i].y);
      context.fill();return;
    }
    context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-trailLength,0);
    context.bezierCurveTo(-trailLength*.65,-radius*width*.2,-radius*1.4,-radius*width,0,-radius*width);
    context.lineTo(0,radius*width);
    context.bezierCurveTo(-radius*1.4,radius*width,-trailLength*.65,radius*width*.2,-trailLength,0);context.fill();
  }
  // Wide additive bloom underneath the bright tail makes its fading gradient feel emissive.
  context.fillStyle=tail;context.globalAlpha=fade*.65;
  drawTrail(2.2);
  context.globalAlpha=fade;
  drawTrail(1.15);
  context.filter='none';drawTrail(.7);
  // A second thin pass reads as hot plasma rather than a translucent flat tail.
  drawTrail(.22);
  // Pure additive light fades to transparency: no opaque sphere, colored rim or hard outline.
  const light=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*2);
  light.addColorStop(0,tint('rgba(255,250,255,.95)'));
  light.addColorStop(.2,tint('rgba(255,235,252,.8)'));
  light.addColorStop(.45,tint('rgba(255,185,239,.45)'));
  light.addColorStop(.7,tint('rgba(255,125,220,.15)'));
  light.addColorStop(1,tint('rgba(255,100,210,0)'));
  context.fillStyle=light;
  context.beginPath();context.arc(0,0,radius*2,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();

}

import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {spawnTestDrop} from './exp-drops.js';
/** Damage adds whole percentage points and sets the inclusive extra-Credits range. */
export function luxeryTuningValues(damage,baseChancePercent){
  const bonus=Math.floor(Math.min(100,Math.max(0,damage))/10);
  return {chance:(baseChancePercent+bonus)/100,maxExtraCredits:bonus};
}
export function tryLuxeryTuningHit({player,enemy,damage,random=Math.random,weaponId='plana-umbrella'}){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  if(main!==weaponId||!player.tuningParts||!(damage>0))return false;
  const base=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'creditChancePercent');if(!base)return false;
  const {chance,maxExtraCredits}=luxeryTuningValues(damage,base);if(random()>=chance)return false;
  const value=1+Math.min(maxExtraCredits,Math.floor(random()*(maxExtraCredits+1)));
  return spawnTestDrop('credits',value,enemy.x,enemy.y);
}
